notes:
- Settings opens inside the Lockwell window, with Done to go back, instead of a window of its own.
- Touch ID asks straight away, names Lockwell in its prompt, and the button shows a fingerprint.
- After a few unlocks with your master password, Lockwell offers to unlock with Touch ID next time. Not now means it never asks again.
- A license screen with a free trial. After the trial every vault still unlocks, searches, copies, backs up and exports; adding and changing items needs a license.
- Quit and Command-Q quit Lockwell.
- Messages under a field no longer squeeze it, and buttons no longer break onto two lines.
